description: This is a PHP unit test class for the EmploymentContractAPI, testing various API endpoints related to employment contracts in the OrangeHRM system. It covers methods like getting, updating, deleting employment contracts and contract attachments, and validating rules.

classes.name: EmploymentContractAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for EmploymentContractAPI, covering retrieval, update, delete, and validation of employment contracts and attachments within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initial setup for the tests, truncates specific database tables to ensure a clean state.

methods.name: testGetEmploymentContractService
methods.description: Tests that the API properly returns an EmploymentContractService instance.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures the delete functionality throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validates that the getValidationRuleForDelete method also throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a specific employment contract by employee number, verifying default and existing data.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates validation rules for fetching a single employment contract.

methods.name: testUpdateOnlyDates
methods.description: Tests partial update of start and end dates for an employment contract.

methods.name: updateOnlyDatesDataProvider
methods.description: Provides multiple data scenarios for testing date updates.

methods.name: testUpdateNewContractAttachment
methods.description: Tests adding a new contract attachment when none exists previously.

methods.name: testUpdateNewContractAttachmentBadRequest
methods.description: Ensures that invalid attachment update requests produce a bad request error.

methods.name: testUpdateDeleteContractAttachment
methods.description: Tests deletion of current contract attachment.

methods.name: testUpdateReplaceContractAttachment
methods.description: Tests replacing an existing contract attachment with a new one.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Checks validation rules for updating an employment contract.

methods.name: setDateTimeHelper
methods.description: Helper method to set a fixed DateTime for consistent test results.
